fadvise64.reason: every POSIX_FADV_* advice variant is warned away as ignored and the syscall always returns success without any effect; see kernel/core/src/syscall/fadvise64.rs

unsupported_success_paths.reason: writeback I/O errors are dropped instead of being recorded, so a later fsync/fdatasync/msync/syncfs reports success for data that was never written; cited in docs/roadmap.md Reference (writeback errors)
